evidence.title: The Emergence of Relevance Through Axiomatic Attention Patterns During LoRA Fine-Tuning

summary: Researchers discovered that fine‑tuning large language models with LoRA induces emergent relevance by shaping attention patterns that follow defined axiomatic principles. The insight offers a potential pathway to more interpretable and efficient model adaptation.
title: Study reveals relevance emergence via axiomatic attention patterns in LoRA fine‑tuning
